stories.label: World · Life & safety
stories.head: Drone hits a market transport hub
bullets: Residents and medics told Al Jazeera 80 were killed on Sunday evening; local groups say about 150.
The RSF-aligned Tasis alliance blamed an army drone; the reports carry no army response.
The UN says it is alarmed by continued deadly drone strikes on civilians.

stories.label: World · Life & safety
stories.head: Three days of airstrikes
bullets: Strikes from 16 to 18 October also injured 11, The Irrawaddy reports.
A strike on a WiFi shop in Yesagyo killed 12 (NUG) to 15 (local media).
The defence minister defended military operations as steps toward peace.

stories.label: India · Land
stories.head: Evicted from forest land
bullets: Most were Bengali-speaking Muslims; residents say they lived there for decades.
Residents say more than 10 mosques were demolished.
The state says it is reclaiming reserve forest land after a court rejected their claims.

stories.label: India · Due process
stories.head: Protesters ask High Court for release
bullets: Saurav Das and Ashutosh Ranka have been held since 13 October over Jantar Mantar.
They sought an urgent night hearing, citing the right to liberty.
The magistrate found their sureties unsatisfactory and said they could breach the peace.
